conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting leveraged ETFs and high-beta names. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leverage and high-conviction setups. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs, which can lead to substantial drawdowns and daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the heightened risk.
